description: Create a conda package and job bundle sample for the Maya USD plugin (Autodesk maya-usd), build the package, and test rendering a USD scene on AWS Deadline Cloud

technologyConstraints.mayaVersion: Maya 2026.0 (API 20260000, cut 202502240946) is the version in the deadline-cloud conda channel
technologyConstraints.mayaUsdVersion: 0.32.0 is the compatible version for Maya 2026.0. 0.33+ requires Maya 2026.2+ due to dual-USD (MULTI_USD_VERSION) and Ufe ABI changes
technologyConstraints.mayaUsdVersionIncompatibility: MayaUSD 0.35.0 was built for Maya 2026.3 and fails with 'undefined symbol: _ZNK6Ufe_v614TypedAttributeIjE4typeB5cxx11Ev' on Maya 2026.0. The .mod file also uses $MULTI_USD_VERSION which Maya 2026.0 does not set (feature added in 2026.2)
technologyConstraints.linuxOnly: Linux-64 platform only for initial implementation
technologyConstraints.condaBuildTool: Use rattler-build format for recipes (not conda-build)
technologyConstraints.installerIssue: The .run installer is a Makeself archive with two interactive prompts: (1) license text piped through 'less -e' which hijacks the terminal, and (2) a menu asking 1=Install, 2=Extract, 3=Exit. To run non-interactively: create a fake 'less' script (#!/bin/sh\ncat > /dev/null), prepend it to PATH, then pipe 'yes\n2' to stdin.
technologyConstraints.customCondaChannel: Queue environment updated to use custom S3 conda channel s3://rendering-agent-spaces-workshop/Conda/Default as first channel before deadline-cloud. Queue IAM role already has s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on the Conda/ prefix.
technologyConstraints.pluginLoadingIssues: MayaUSD plugin requires: (1) .mod file in a directory on MAYA_MODULE_PATH, (2) LD_LIBRARY_PATH to include Maya lib dir and MayaUSD lib dir for shared library dependencies. The job template uses a shell wrapper (run.sh) to set these before launching mayapy.

userStories.title: Test maya-usd installer extraction locally
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to figure out how to extract the maya-usd .run installer non-interactively before creating the conda recipe
acceptanceCriteria: Download the MayaUSD_0.35.0_Maya2026.3_Linux.run installer to a temp directory
Test running the installer with --help or --info to discover available flags
Find the correct flags to extract/install non-interactively (e.g., --noexec --target, or yes | ./installer, or similar)
Document the working extraction command in progress.txt
Identify where the plugin files are installed (modules, plug-ins directories)
userStories.notes: SOLVED: The .run file is a Makeself 2.3.0 archive. It has MS_PrintLicense() which pipes license through 'less -e' (hijacks terminal, blocks stdin piping), then a menu (1=Install requiring root, 2=Extract, 3=Exit). Simple 'echo yes | ./installer' does NOT work because less consumes the terminal. Fix: create a fake less that discards output (#!/bin/sh\ncat > /dev/null), put it first on PATH, then pipe 'yes\n2'. Use --nox11 to prevent xterm spawn and --target DIR to set extraction path. The embedded script is ./setup.sh. Use --noexec to skip running it if only extraction is needed.

userStories.notes: Multiple submit attempts failed due to: (1) MayaUSD 0.35.0 ABI incompatibility with Maya 2026.0 - undefined symbol in libusdUfe.so from Ufe_v6 mismatch, (2) MULTI_USD_VERSION env var unset (Maya 2026.0 doesn't support it, added in 2026.2), (3) .mod file paths not resolving, (4) LD_LIBRARY_PATH not set for Maya/MayaUSD shared libs. Job template updated with shell wrapper (run.sh) to set LD_LIBRARY_PATH and MAYA_PLUG_IN_PATH before launching mayapy. Blocked on rebuilding conda package with MayaUSD 0.32.0.
